name: Jentic Strapi CMS - Page Metadata API
description: Minimal spec for the Jentic strapi-cms `page-metadata` collection (Strapi 5.46 auto-generated REST CRUD). One entry per site route, keyed by `pagePath`, holding SEO fields. `robotsIndex`/`robotsFollow` control sitemap inclusion. Note the doubled plural in the path: Strapi serves the `page-metadata` content type at `/api/page-metadatas`. Strapi 5 identifies records by the string `documentId`; the `{id}` path parameter accepts that documentId.
